routine.return: a pointer in rax: the constant 0x64ddc20 when the gate is open and the index is in range, else 0 (NULL)

branches.condition: gate byte A at 0x6713606 is 0 (cmpb $0x0; je)
branches.result: return NULL; gate byte B, the index and the base pointer are never consulted

branches.condition: gate byte A is non-zero but gate byte B at 0x6717690 is not exactly 1 (cmpb $0x1; jne)
branches.result: return NULL; the index and the base pointer are never consulted

branches.condition: both gate bytes open but the unsigned index in rcx is > 0x23 (cmp $0x23; ja)
both gate bytes open and the unsigned index in rcx is <= 0x23
branches.result: return the fixed pointer 0x64ddc20; the index does not scale or offset the result

reads.role: gate byte A; routine returns NULL when this byte is 0 (byte compare, only the low 8 bits matter)
gate byte B; routine returns NULL unless this byte is exactly 1 (byte compare)
unsigned index; must be <= 0x23 (inclusive) or the routine returns NULL; never used to index the returned pointer

returns_constant.note: RIP-relative lea of a fixed address; this is the qword slot 8 bytes after the routine's own installed pointer slot 0x64ddc18, and it carries no relocation of its own (it is the address of inline data, not a stored pointer)

following_pointer_slot.note: points into .rodata; its meaning is observed-only and not claimed

sibling_routine.note: same byte-gated shape with a different base pointer and bound; listed as a negative control, not characterised here

stored_qwords: file offset 0x132eb0, the .rela.dyn addend of the RELATIVE record

neighbour_note: the bytes after the ret (0x636c8aa..0x636c8b0 is a nopw fill inside the body; 0x636c8b3..0x636c8c0 is int3 (0xcc) padding); the next FDE (0x636c8c0..0x636c8f3) is the sibling routine, not part of this one
never_read_or_written: any memory other than the two fixed .bss gate bytes
any object offset derived from the rcx index (the index only gates, it never indexes)
the routine writes nothing and makes no calls, so it has no landing-pad block
